class.name: ResonancePlayer
class.brief_description: Steam Audio source with occlusion, transmission, reverb, and pathing on top of AudioStreamPlayer3D.
class.description: Extends [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. Assign a [url=#ResonancePlayerConfig]ResonancePlayerConfig[/url] to [member player_config] for Steam occlusion, distance, air absorption, directivity, reflections, and pathing. Without a config this node is a plain [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. With a config, Godot spatial knobs are hidden and Godot attenuation is forced off; [code]volume_db[/code], [code]max_db[/code], [code]pitch_scale[/code], [code]max_polyphony[/code], and the play API still apply. Overlapping voices share one Steam source at this node. See docs/DEVELOPERS.md for the ASP3D ownership split. [method get_stream] is your user [AudioStream]; the engine plays an internal wrapper. AnimationPlayer Audio Clips stay dry unless you use [member convert_anim_audio_runtime] or [method play_animation_audio_clip]. Steam fields live on the config; pathing volume stays on [member pathing_probe_volume].

method.name: set_stream
method.description: With [member player_config], stores the user [AudioStream] and drives an internal Resonance wrapper. Without a config, sets the plain [AudioStreamPlayer3D] stream slot.

method.name: get_stream
method.description: With [member player_config], returns the user [AudioStream] (not the internal wrapper). Without a config, returns the [AudioStreamPlayer3D] stream.

method.name: get_inner_stream
method.description: Same as [method get_stream]. Convenience for VOIP, mic, and generator scripts.

method.name: get_inner_stream_playback
method.description: Returns the decoder [AudioStreamPlayback] under the Resonance wrapper. Without [member player_config], same as [method AudioStreamPlayer3D.get_stream_playback].

method.name: play
method.description: Starts playback from [param from_position]. With [member player_config], wraps the stream, ensures a Steam source (retries if the server was not ready), and starts the reverb-split child when needed.

method.name: play_stream
method.description: Calls [method play] with the same [param from_position]. Alias for existing projects and tutorials.

method.name: play_animation_audio_clip
method.description: Sets [code]stream[/code] and calls [method play]. Use from AnimationPlayer method tracks, or after [member convert_anim_audio_runtime] rewrites Audio Clip tracks.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback. With [member player_config], soft-stops dry input so reverb/pathing tails can drain; without a config (or in the editor), hard-stops like [AudioStreamPlayer3D].

method.name: set_reverb_split_output
method.description: When [param enable] is true, creates child [code]ResonanceReverbOutput[/code] ([AudioStreamPlayer]) for Parametric/Hybrid wet. Optional [param reverb_bus] sets that child's bus; it does not mirror parent mute or bus automatically.

method.name: get_reverb_split_output
method.description: Returns whether the [code]ResonanceReverbOutput[/code] child path is enabled.

method.name: reload_source_after_reinit
method.description: Drops the Steam source handle and recreates it after a server reinit. [ResonanceRuntime] calls this; scripts rarely need it.

method.name: get_audio_instrumentation
method.description: Debug counters when [member player_config] is set: [code]godot_*[/code] field snapshot, [code]effective_volume_linear[/code], and when voices are active [code]polyphony_voice_count[/code] plus dropout totals. Empty without a config.

method.name: reset_audio_instrumentation
method.description: Clears instrumentation counters on every active internal playback for this node.

method.name: get_effective_volume_linear_cached
method.description: Linear source loudness from [code]min(volume_db, max_db)[/code], refreshed each frame and applied to the dry buffer before Steam DSP. Use config [code]direct_mix_level[/code] for dry-only level.

method.name: build_directivity_gizmo_lines
method.description: Line-list wireframe (pairs of [Vector3], forward [code]-Z[/code]) for editor and runtime gizmos. Simulation mode ([param input_mode] [code]0[/code]) draws a dipole from [param weight]/[param power]; otherwise a unit sphere plus arrow (scaled by [param user_value] in user mode).

method.name: set_inputs
method.description: Refresh config and push this player's Steam Source [code]SetInputs[/code] (blocking) before the next sim tick. Optional [param flags] is reserved (Direct / Reflections / Pathing bits); default applies all. No-op without [member player_config] or a live source handle.

method.name: get_outputs
method.description: Simulation readback for this source: [code]occlusion[/code], [code]transmission[/code], [code]air_absorption[/code], [code]directivity[/code], [code]distance_attenuation[/code], plus [code]reflections_mix_level[/code], [code]pathing_mix_level[/code], [code]reflections_enabled[/code], [code]distance_attenuation_enabled[/code] from the config cache. Empty without a config or handle. No IR pointers.

members.member: [url=#ResonancePlayerConfig]ResonancePlayerConfig[/url] for Steam processing. Null = plain [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. Resource fields are documented on that class.
Optional [ResonanceProbeVolume] for path finding when [member player_config] is set. Empty = first loaded pathing volume. Clear before deleting a referenced volume.
When [code]scene_type[/code] is Custom, registers descendant [CollisionObject3D] RIDs with [ResonanceServer] so occlusion rays ignore this source's colliders. Disable to let those bodies block rays.

At runtime with [member player_config], converts targeting AnimationPlayer Audio Clip tracks once into method keys for [method play_animation_audio_clip] (Steam-safe; native polyphonic Audio Clips stay dry).
Hides this player from the debug overlay Audio Instrumentation list.
Shows the directivity wireframe in the editor viewport and at runtime (forward [code]-Z[/code]). Shape follows [member player_config] directivity fields; independent of the debug HUD.

constants.constant: Inverse distance on Direct ([code]min/distance[/code], [member ResonancePlayerConfig.max_distance] ignored). Same Phonon InverseDistance TYPE on Pathing/Reflections when distance attenuation is on.

Linear falloff to silence at max distance on Direct playback; Pathing uses the CALLBACK model on path length; Reflections CALLBACK only with [member ResonancePlayerConfig.use_distance_curve_for_reflections].
Custom [Curve] rolloff from [member ResonancePlayerConfig.attenuation_curve] (same Pathing/Reflections rules as Linear).
No distance rolloff on Direct; Phonon default distance model on wet slots.
